text: WEXCOMBE, Nov. 13 — The Aldermoor hoard is now held by the Wexcombe Museum, people familiar with the matter said. The transfer was completed this week after a closed-door review by trustees and the estate of collector Emil Varr. Museum registrar Leona Pryce confirmed the cache arrived under sealed transport on Tuesday and was logged alongside 214 catalogued objects, including silver rings, glass beads and a hammered bronze torc. The hoard had been stored temporarily at the North Fen Conservation Depot since its recovery in May. Curators said the museum plans a public display in early spring, pending final conservation work and security upgrades.
